headline: ADS BUILT TO LOOK LIKE CREATOR CONTENT WERE 30 PERCENT LESS LIKELY TO BE TOP PERFORMERS ACROSS 3,300 TESTED ADS, AND HAD THE WEAKEST BRAND CONNECTION OF ANYTHING MEASURED
deck: Zappi tested more than 3,300 social video ads with real viewers and ranked what actually drives performance.  The creator look came last.  Read it next to Monday's lead and the two findings do not fight each other, they explain each other.
tldr: Zappi tested more than 3,300 social video ads in the UK and US and found that ads designed to resemble creator content were 30 percent less likely to be top performers and had the weakest brand connection of any characteristic studied, while three or more distinctive brand assets was the only characteristic that substantially improved it.  Open your last five creator-style paid assets, count the distinctive brand assets excluding logo and pack shot, and add one brand colour, slogan or recurring character wherever the count is under three.

Tubefilter's weekly branded video chart has a 48.2 million view Short at the top of it and is the first edition published since YouTube introduced its first-frame view metric, which Tubefilter says raised view counts across the whole board.  Date-stamp every view benchmark in your reporting deck, mark anything set before 24 August as not comparable, and set the next target on average view duration instead.

Shapermint says it is on track for 10 million dollars in TikTok Shop sales with more than 5,000 affiliate creators, 60 percent of its top performers over the age of 35, and more than 5,000 videos posted in the last 30 days off weekly creative briefs shared in a Discord channel.  Match the creator age band on your next flight to the age band in your own sales data, and set up one weekly channel that tells your creators what worked and what to copy.

NowThis made 20 shows last year and got three hits, and is making 30 this year targeting six, which is the clearest hit rate anybody has published for creator-style owned video.  Split your next branded series budget into four or five cheaper pilots, write the kill criteria before you shoot, and give the client the expected hit rate up front.

VALORANT Champions' group stage peaked at 718.3K viewers, up 7.8 percent year over year, while average concurrents fell 11 percent and hours watched fell 11.5 percent across 410 separate channels, and Kick took 7.7 percent of the hours off almost nothing last year.  Ask for peak concurrents, average concurrents, hours watched and channel count on one page for every live proposal, and price against the average.

Agencies report Amazon ad spend up 15 to 40 percent year on year ahead of October Prime Day, with Amazon's buying platform up 25 to 30 percent and non-endemic spend up 40, while average Prime Day discount depth fell from 28 percent in 2024 to 24 percent last year.  Frame your next video proposal against the discount it replaces, with the margin arithmetic on the first page and incrementality rather than impressions as the headline measure.

Crocs is three seasons into a serial drama of 60-to-90-second cliffhanger episodes running in the TikTok feed beside its own shopping streams, and David's Bridal is funding its series out of a collapsing paid search budget on the rule that the more radical the deviation from tradition, the higher the viewership.  Write a five-episode version of whatever your category films respectfully, and schedule it next to a shoppable surface you already run rather than on a separate brand channel.
